import json, subprocess, sys, glob
from pathlib import Path
D = Path(sys.argv[1]); SDIP = sys.argv[2]
from tests.fixtures.generators.hostile import build_combination
items = [l.strip() for l in open(D / "items.txt") if l.strip()]
out = []
for k, name in enumerate(items):
    src = build_combination(D / "corpus", tuple(name.split("+")))
    store = D / f"c{k}.mdio"
    p = subprocess.run([SDIP, "certify", str(src), str(store)], cwd=D / "repo", capture_output=True, text=True)
    certs = sorted((D / "repo").rglob("*.json"), key=lambda q: q.stat().st_mtime)
    cert = json.loads(certs[-1].read_text()) if certs else {}
    planes = {k2: (v.get("status") if isinstance(v, dict) else v) for k2, v in (cert.get("planes") or {}).items()} if isinstance(cert.get("planes"), dict) else cert.get("planes")
    out.append({"item": name, "exit": p.returncode, "verdict": cert.get("verdict"), "gates": cert.get("gates"),
                "planes": planes, "stderr_tail": p.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-2:] if p.stderr else []})
    for c in certs: c.unlink()
print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))

"""P34: FIVE_ORDER members, in order, until the cap through the D8 child, judged by P15's clauses. JSONL records."""
import json, shutil, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

if __name__ == "__main__":
    root, out, cap = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3])
    from sdip.ingest import ingest
    from tests.fixtures.generators.hostile import FIVE_ORDER, build_combination, build_positive_control
    from tests.negative.test_d8_hostile_corpus import _run_one
    from tests.negative.test_d8_hostile_pairs import falsifier_hits
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    control = build_positive_control(root / "corpus")
    store = root / "control.mdio"
    ingest(control, store)
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    with out.open("w") as fh:
        for q in FIVE_ORDER:
            if time.monotonic() - t0 > cap:
                fh.write(json.dumps({"cap_reached": True}) + "\n"); break
            name = "+".join(q); s = time.monotonic()
            source = build_combination(root / "corpus", q)
            run = _run_one(name, "five", source, root, store)
            hits = falsifier_hits(run)
            rep = run.report or {}
            api = rep.get("api") or {}
            rec = {"item": name, "seconds": round(time.monotonic() - s, 2), "hits": hits,
                   "api": api.get("outcome"), "type": api.get("type"),
                   "raised_in": "sdip" if api.get("is_sdip_error") else api.get("module"),
                   "exit": {p: (rep.get(p) or {}).get("exit_code") for p in ("cli", "verify", "export", "certify")},
                   "peak_rss": rep.get("peak_rss_bytes")}
            fh.write(json.dumps(rec) + "\n"); fh.flush()
            shutil.rmtree(root / "runs" / name, ignore_errors=True); source.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        fh.write(json.dumps({"elapsed_s": round(time.monotonic() - t0, 1)}) + "\n")
